detail: Wide form of Questionnaire_data_long (gumundsdottir_2026_osf_6): one row per participant, the five waves of self-esteem items as columns.
Three coders' agency and communion ratings of 281 narratives, one row per narrative, no participant id column; inter-rater reliability data, not a model table.
Meta-analysis input with one row per study (3 studies); the effect size and variance are computed in the deposit's R script, not stored, and one observation per study leaves no repeated grouping.
Meta-analysis input with one row per study (3 studies); the effect size and variance are computed in the deposit's R script, not stored, and one observation per study leaves no repeated grouping.
Raw extraction (519 rows, includes the Exclude flag) from which MA_dataset_with_ES.csv (lagisz_2020_osf_3) is computed; it holds means and SDs but no effect size column.
Codebook of the dataset's columns (column name and description), not observations.
The rows of MA_dataset_with_ES.csv (lagisz_2020_osf_3) plus subset flag columns (unique, abs_d, max_ES, biggest_ES and their scale-point variants).

Species-level look-up of mass and percentage body mass feeding the alternative candidate models, derived from the records of the Pcrit table (Data/Pcrit data for 195 fish species ( 2022_02_14).csv); it has no Pcrit response.
Wide form of df1_long (one row per participant, per-participant means of the three vignettes).
Wide form of df2_long (one row per participant, per-participant means of the three vignettes).
Wide form of df3_long (one row per participant, per-participant means of the three vignettes).

Sample annotation (patient, sample, disease status, tissue, data availability flags); these are covariates of the paper's biospecimen model, but the drug response lives in File_3 (a wide drug by sample matrix) and not here.
Clinical summary of the Helsinki cohort, one row per patient; the paper's drug-response mixed models pool several cohorts (993 samples, 46 drugs) and none uses this table.
Codebook of File_1.1 (variable, significance, unit), not observations.
Drug library (one row per compound: names, class, concentrations, supplier), a look-up of the cited cohort deposit.

Assay details per sample (medium, blast percentage, cell viability, serial flag); the paper's models explain drug sensitivity scores from File_3, which is a wide matrix, and none uses cell viability as a response.
Variant allele frequencies as a gene by sample matrix (340 genes, 225 sample columns); exome data of the cited cohort, no model of the paper.
Binary mutation calls as a gene by sample matrix (57 genes, 225 sample columns); exome data of the cited cohort, no model of the paper.
Raw RNA-seq read counts as a gene by sample matrix (60,619 genes); expression data of the cited cohort, no mixed model of the paper.
RNA-seq library and extraction method per sample, one row per sample; annotation of the cited cohort, no model of the paper.

Pedigree (animal, father, mother), one row per bird, no phenotype; it supplies the relatedness structure of the animal model whose data are in phenotypic_data_for_animal_model.xlsx (kappers_2018_osf_4).

Juvenile subset of phenotypic_data_for_animal_model.xlsx (kappers_2018_osf_4) with parental morphs and recoded three-morph scenarios, built for the Mendelian inheritance tests; the paper's mixed model is fitted on the phenotypic file.
Per-session administration and covariate sheet (timings, weight, squat and bench 1RM, age, supplement notes), no modelled response.

Wide per-session sheet: glucose at six and lactate at three time points as columns (48 rows, participant by condition); the paper's models (response ~ condition * time with participant slopes) need the long form with time as a column, which is not deposited.

Wide per-session sheet: hunger, satiety and fullness at four time points as columns (48 rows, participant by condition); the paper's models need the long form with time as a column, which is not deposited.
Raw line-intercept log measurements, aggregated per plot into Measurement_plots.xlsx (liutu_2026_zenodo_3), where the paper's models run.
Raw tree-level measurements, aggregated per plot into Measurement_plots.xlsx (liutu_2026_zenodo_3), where the paper's models run.
SNP calls in HapMap format (one row per marker, one column per line); a genotype matrix with no response and no grouping column.
SNP map (name, chromosome, position), one row per marker; no response.
Numeric SNP matrix with one row per line (283) and about 26,000 marker columns; genotype data with no repeated grouping, the GWAS phenotype is in Supplementary_Data.1.
Crab mass for each feeding-assay replicate, one row per replicate within site and trial (120 rows); a replicate-level covariate with no repeated observations.

Wide survey table, one row per participant (648), with each behaviour as a block of columns (RD02, RD03, RD04 per behaviour); the paper's behaviour by participant long form is built in Analysis.Rmd and not deposited.
